questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Nakul asked her, "How do you know that Rahul has told this to him?"

options.text: Nakul asked her how she knew that Rahul had told that to him.
Nakul asked her that how she has known that Rahul has told that to him.
Nakul asked her how she knew that Rahul has told that to him.
Nakul asked her that how she knows that Rahul had told that to him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Nakul asked her how she knew that Rahul had told that to him.'**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation as follows: 
 
 
• 'Asked' will not change because the given sentence is an 'Interrogative sentence'. 
 
• 'How' will be used as a conjunction because we know that in an interrogative sentence with a question word the question word itself is used as a conjunction. 
 
• **'You' **will be changed into** 'she' **because second-person pronouns are changed according to **the reporting verb** of the sentence in **'direct to indirect' **transformation. 
 
• We know that in the **'direct to indirect' **transformation **'First form' **of the verb is changed into **'Second form'** of **the verb. **
 
• **'Has told' **will be changed into** 'Had told'. **
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is** Option 1.** 

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__*** Nakul asked her how she knew that Rahul had told that to him.​ *

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

This android can perform all the programmes perfectly well.

options.text: All the programmes can be performed perfectly well by this android.
All the programmes could have been performed perfectly well by this android.
All the programmes can have been performed perfectly well by this android.
All the programmes could be performed perfectly well by this android.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'All the programmes can be performed perfectly well by this android.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** Active Voice.** As per the question we have to change it into **Passive Voice. **
 
• The process of transformation as follows:
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is** 'The android'.**
 
• The object of the given sentence is **'All the programmes'. **
 
• T**he structure of the transformation of Modals: **
 
 
• **Subject+Modals+V1+Object. (Active Voice)**
 
• **Subject(objective case)+Modals+be+V3+by+object(subjective case). (Passive Voice)**
 
 
 
• *Example: *
 
 
• *Animals cannot make tools. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Tools cannot be made by animals. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• We know that in **Active To Passive** transformation** 'can perform'** will be changed into** 'can be performed'. ** 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1. **

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__** *All the programmes can be performed perfectly well by this android. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Transformation of Infinitives: Structure of it as follows:

__
 
• Subject+is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had+to+V1+Object. 
 
• Subject(Objective case)+is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had+to+be+V3+by+object(subjective case). 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Your child is to learn chess. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Chess is to be learnt by your child. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__***We do not change the tense of a verb when we convert a sentence from the active to the passive voice or vice versa.***__

questions.question:
**Given below are four Jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. He was on a pilgrimage to Jerusalem.

B. The villagers were kind though doubtful.

C. They offered him some food to eat and a room to stay.

D. One night, he took rest in a village unfamiliar on the way.
questions.solution:

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, the starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Here, in the given question **Part A** will be the **first** sentence because it is the starting of an incident. 
 
• **Part D** will be the next sentence because **Part A **talks about the pilgrimage of the person. And **Part D** tells us where he took shelter. 
 
• Part B will be the next because it describes the behavior of Villagers. 
 
• Lastly, **Part C** will be used because **Part C** tells us how Villagers treated him. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 3. **

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__** *He was on a pilgrimage to Jerusalem. One night, he took rest in a village unfamiliar on the way. The villagers were kind though doubtful. They offered him some food to eat and a room to stay.*

questions.question: What is the atomic weight of Lithium ?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**"6.941 amu, g/mol".**__

__
 
• The atomic weight of terrestrial and commercial lithium sources varies between 6.9387 and 6.9959
 
• It has the atomic symbol Li, atomic number 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The **total** **weight** of an **atom** is called the** atomic weight.**
 
• It is approximately equal to the number of **protons** and **neutrons**, with a little extra added by the **electrons**.
 
• The standard unit of atomic mass has been one-twelfth the mass of an atom of the** isotope carbon-12.**
 
• An isotope is one of two or more species of atoms of the same chemical element that have different atomic mass numbers (protons + neutrons).
 
• The atomic weight of helium is 4.002602, the average that reflects the typical ratio of natural abundances of its isotopes.
 
• **Atomic weight** is **measured** in **atomic mass units** (**AMU**), also called **daltons.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lithium compounds,** also known as** lithium salts,** are primarily used as **psychiatric medication.**
 
• It appears to be **safe** to use while **breastfeeding**.
 
• **Lithium** **salts** are classified as **mood stabilizers.**
 
• Lithium is used primarily for **bipolar disorder.**
 
• In the nineteenth century, lithium was used in people who had gout, epilepsy, and cancer.
 
• Its use in the treatment of mental disorders began in 1948 by John Cade in Australia.
 
• It is on the World Health Organization's List of** Essential Medicines.**
